name: Nova Pascucci
source: She’s a strong, down-to-earth tomboy who is the academy’s top athlete and captain of the kickboxing club. She helps out with many of the other sports related clubs and spends a lot of her free time with them. She believes that hard work and devotion is what goes into building great things in return.
